payload.rebuttal: fixed: test_both_callers_refuse_a_reprompt_on_the_one_rule called run_wrong_versions through a helper that passed emit=lambda _e: None, so every event the wrong-version path emitted was thrown away before the test could see it. A mutant that gave run_wrong_versions its own on_reprompt callback, making it announce a re-prompt the same way run_lens does, produced no visible difference and the witness stayed green. I added an emit parameter to _run_wrong_version_entries (still defaulting to the no-op sink for other callers) and had this witness pass a real list, then assert it stays empty. Replaying the exact wrong-version edit from the finding against this test now fails it, and I reverted that probe edit afterward.
